review:
Gothic horror with mirrors and creepy twin girls. Summoning symbols land in three sizes and reveal a stack of one symbol or wild – and when they're part of a win, they stay while everything else cascades away, then reveal again.

A wild landing right above or below a Summoning symbol makes it grow to cover it, so stacks get bigger as a sequence goes on. The Shattered and Twisted bonuses summon more often. 10,000x max. One of Hacksaw's darkest-looking games.
